name: TwistingData.index_mul_finrank_excessCond_le
summary: Write k for the rank of the statement and k′ = k − 1 for the variable that Lean calls k after line 176 (`obtain ⟨_ | k, …⟩ := k`). dim excessCond ≤ [L : L∩ℐ]·vol(excessCone a' (h + N(k+1)) ∩ slab k (n + k + 1)). Shift by τ = (h + N(k+1))σ, σ ∈ excessCone a' (−1): the shifted set lies in excessCone a' 0 ∩ slab k D, where D(j) = n + k + 1 + Σ_b τ(b, j) (the upper endpoint of the slab moves by the column sum of τ in each letter j). [GL_k(W) : 𝒫]·[L : L∩ℐ] ≤ [GL_k(W) : ℐ] ≤ [GL_k(κ_W) : B], ℐ being the preimage of the lower Borel subgroup B of GL_k over the residue field κ_W of W (a relative-index inequality), and [GL_k(κ_W) : B] is at most the number of full flags Π_l (q^l − 1)/(q − 1); flags × vol(excessCone a' 0 ∩ slab k D) = vol(slab k D) (prod_mul_volume_inter_slab). The slab volume is at most a product over the N letters of simplex volumes, each at most |(e^{1/h}n)^{k−1}/(k−1)!| because D(j) ≤ e^{1/h}·n by the size condition on n/h (the shift, the enlarged slab and this condition are matched), and the size conditions turn the product into (1 + κ)·m^N, m = #Monomials (Fin k) n.

Index bookkeeping: [GL_k(W) : 𝒫]·[L : L ∩ ℐ] ≤ [GL_k(W) : 𝒫]·[𝒫 : ℐ] = [GL_k(W) : ℐ] (relIndex_le_of_le_right with L ⊆ 𝒫, relIndex_mul_index with ℐ ⊆ 𝒫; both inclusions are left as goals).
